name: Conduct Base
description: Core AI governance rules — proxy interception, agent safety, surface-aware enforcement, workflow governance, and MCP server tool call auditing. 5 proxy + 14 agent + 7 surface + 4 workflow + 2 MCP rules.

rules.description: Gate production deploys behind admin approval
rules.message: Production deploy proposed by an AI agent. Admin approval required before this executes.

enforcement.guarantee: Halts workflow execution and creates a Guard approval request. The workflow runtime does not resume until a permitted approver decides (approved → continue, rejected → abort). Hook and MCP surfaces pause the agent's next action pending the same decision.
requires: Approver has platform.approvals.decide permission
Workspace has at least one member with the admin role
known_limitations: Hook/MCP enforcement depends on the agent invoking guard_check before the tool call
Proxy surface returns 428 with pending marker — the agent must retry after human approval
